p:Lax606786Proofs.bernstein_measurable.label:
On a separable space `ρ_k(T)` is a supremum over a countable dense family of subspaces of functions
continuous in `T`.
p:Lax606786Proofs.bernstein_measurable.tooltipHtml: On a separable space ρk(T)ρ_k(T)ρk​(T) is a supremum over a countable dense family of subspaces of functions continuous in TTT.

p:Lax606786Proofs.measurable_apply_of_we.label:
On a separable space a measurable `v` is a pointwise limit of countably-valued measurable
functions; for each of these the claim is a countable case split, and the limit passes through
because each `A(ω)` is continuous.
p:Lax606786Proofs.measurable_apply_of_we.tooltipHtml: On a separable space a measurable vvv is a pointwise limit of countably-valued measurable functions; for each of these the claim is a countable case split, and the limit passes through because each A(ω)A(ω)A(ω) is continuous.

p:Lax606786Proofs.measurable_bernstein_o.label:
`ρ_k` is a countable supremum over a dense family of subspaces of countable infima over dense
subsets of their unit spheres.
p:Lax606786Proofs.measurable_bernstein_o.tooltipHtml: ρkρ_kρk​ is a countable supremum over a dense family of subspaces of countable infima over dense subsets of their unit spheres.

p:Lax606786Proofs.measurable_growth_of_w.label:
The unit sphere of a nonzero subspace of a separable space is itself separable, so `growth`
against it is a countable infimum: this is the ingredient that makes `g_{A(ω)}(V)` measurable
for a merely *strongly* measurable `A` (measurable in the strong operator topology, i.e.
`ω ↦ A(ω)x` measurable for each fixed `x`).

p:Lax606786Proofs.measurable_pushforward.label:
Measurability into `𝒢_k X` is tested on distances to fixed subspaces, which are computed as
limits of countable suprema over a dense subset of `X`.
